_doc: Office companies in the CBD towers (Offices). Each desk earns `per_desk` a day (x level and +-15%) and costs `wage` a day; the floor's rent is the unit's rent x rent_k. Every company also helps your shops (perk), more with more desks. levels: fit-outs (max desks, productivity).

logistics.name: Logistics
logistics.perk: Your shops' stock deliveries are free (2+ desks), and arrive the same evening at 4+ desks.

marketing.name: Marketing agency
marketing.perk: Every shop gets +2% shoppers per desk (up to +20%).

recruitment.name: Recruitment agency
recruitment.perk: More people looking for work every day, a grade more skilled at 3+ desks; sick staff are covered by temps at 5+.

property.name: Property management
property.perk: Rent on every rented shop falls 2% per desk (up to 20%).

tech.name: Tech studio
tech.perk: Your own card payments: card fees fall 10% per desk (up to 80%).
